title: Kids materials suite
slide_intent: Adapt a shared identity to a distinct audience because recognition should coexist with age-appropriate activity and invitation.
strategic_value: The colored Kids lettering can distinguish Whitney’s education materials while preserving the W and institutional name.
demonstration: A gray flat lay groups a Kids booklet, activity pages, membership card, calendar and activity guide using colored letters and black typography.
practical_value: Compare audience-specific color and lettering with the shared structure across educational objects.

content_islands.name: Upper objects
content_islands.spec: Arrange the booklet, open activity pages and membership card across the top.

content_islands.name: Lower objects
content_islands.spec: Place the June 2013 calendar at lower left and the tall activity guide at lower right.

reference_purposes.Application: The official caption identifies a suite produced for the Education department.
reference_purposes.Expression: The Kids lettering uses separate bright colors within the shared black-line identity.
